title: Afro-Antillean Panama: the workers who built the canal
goal: Talk about the Afro-Antillean workers and their legacy in Panama, granting a point with si bien.
grammar: formal concessive clauses with si bien and the indicative

sections.title: Afro-Antillean Panama: the workers who built the canal
body: In this lesson you read about the workers from the Caribbean islands who came to build the railway and the canal, how they were treated, and what they left in Panamanian life.
The grammar is one you know: *si bien* for granting a point formally. The screens and instructions are in English; the readings are in Spanish.

items: I can grant a point in a formal sentence with *si bien* and the indicative.
I can say who the Afro-Antillean workers were and how the gold and silver lists treated them.
I can use the new words for wages, workers and nationality.
